title: The Toll Bridge
text: A rickety bridge spans a gorge. Underneath, something large clears its throat. 'Toll is ten gold. Or one riddle. Or one of you.'
A troll in a tiny hat blocks the bridge. 'Toll!' it bellows, holding out a hand the size of a cart.
The troll bites each coin, satisfied, and waves you across with surprising courtesy.
{actor} answers before the troll finishes asking. It weeps with joy and gives you its 'shiny rock collection'.
'...a shadow?' The troll gasps. 'Nobody ever gets that one!' You cross in triumph.
{actor}'s answer is technically wrong but so confidently delivered that the troll lets you pass, muttering.
Wrong! The troll shakes the bridge until {actor} falls in the river, then lets you pass, laughing.
{actor}'s answer offends the troll's mother. It attacks!
{actor} roars. The troll squeaks, hides under the bridge, and you stroll across. It leaves its toll jar behind.
The troll is not impressed. 'Rude!' It charges.

title: A Wounded Traveler
text: A traveler lies by the road, clutching a wounded leg. 'Bandits... took everything... please...'
Groaning from the ditch: a merchant, bruised and battered, waves weakly at you.
{actor}'s care is miraculous. The grateful traveler presses a family heirloom into their hands.
The traveler limps away blessing your names, after pointing out a hidden cache the bandits missed.
You do your best. They'll live, though they wince at every step. They thank you anyway.
The traveler points you to the bandits' camp. You catch them counting the loot.
Wait — this 'traveler' is a bandit lookout! The ambush springs!
You walk on. Somewhere, a bard makes a note: 'not very heroic'.

title: The Fairy Ring
text: A perfect circle of glowing mushrooms pulses softly in the dusk. Tiny laughter tinkles from somewhere.
Music drifts from a ring of toadstools. Dancing lights bob within.
{actor} dances so well the fey crown them Midsummer Monarch! They gift the party fey wine and blessings.
The fey are delighted with {actor}'s dancing and bless the party.
{actor} dances for what feels like an hour. It was a day. Still, the fey were amused.
{actor} trips. The fey are insulted and pelt everyone with acorns.
{actor} is spun around and around... and wakes up three days later. Time has passed.
{actor} identifies rare moonshrooms at the edge. They make excellent potions.
The spores make everyone sneeze for an hour. Nothing gained.
Wise. Probably.

title: An Abandoned Cart
text: A merchant's cart lies on its side, oxen gone, crates still strapped down. Too quiet.
A cart, overturned. Barrels, crates, and one very suspicious silence.
{actor} finds a false bottom stuffed with treasure!
Among the crates: useful supplies and a small purse.
A few coins and a jar of pickles. Good pickles, though.
A crate was a trap! Spring-loaded darts hit {actor}.
The 'crate' opens its mouth. MIMIC!
{actor} spots the bandits hiding in the trees and you get the drop on them!
Bandits leap from the trees!

title: Shrine of a Forgotten God
text: A mossy shrine to a god nobody remembers. Offerings of old coins lie at its feet, and the air hums.
A statue with too many arms smiles serenely at you from an overgrown altar.
The god remembers itself through {actor}! Divine light fills the party.
A warm presence answers {actor}'s prayer. Wounds close and spirits lift.
Silence. The god, if it's listening, isn't saying.
You pocket the coins. The statue's smile seems... thinner.
The statue's eyes flare. A curse settles on {actor}!
You leave some coins. A gentle warmth follows the party for days.

title: Howls in the Dark
text: Howls rise all around you. Yellow eyes glint between the trees. The pack is circling.
The wolves have your scent. You hear them, closer every minute.
You form up back-to-back as the pack charges!
{actor} waves a flaming branch and bellows. The wolves slink away.
The alpha isn't fooled. The pack attacks!
{actor} and the alpha share a long look. The pack escorts you safely — and one pup follows you home.
The alpha dips its head and leads the pack away.
The alpha snarls. That's a no.

title: Tavern Brawl
text: A roadside tavern. Someone spills someone's ale. Chairs start flying.
'He looked at my goat!' A brawl erupts in the roadhouse.
{actor} is the last one standing on the bar. The crowd chants their name.
{actor} wins the brawl and the respect of the regulars. Drinks are free.
{actor} gets a stool to the face. Everyone has a great time, mostly.
{actor}'s speech brings tears to the eyes of hardened mercenaries. The innkeeper insists you stay free.
Somebody throws a pie at {actor}. That's it, you're all thrown out.
Nobody notices {actor} lifting purses amid the flying furniture.
Caught! {actor} is chased out with a broom.

title: The Rope Bridge
text: A frayed rope bridge sways over a dizzying chasm. The wind is picking up.
The only way forward is a rope bridge with more holes than planks.

options.label: Cross carefully, one at a time

text: One by one, you make it across. Your knees will stop shaking eventually.
Most of you cross fine. {actor} nearly falls and is hauled up, bruised.
A plank snaps! Several of you dangle before scrambling across.
The long way is safe but slow.

title: Goblin Checkpoint
text: Three goblins have built a 'checkpoint' out of sticks. 'Papers!' squeaks one. 'Or gold!' squeaks another.
A hand-painted sign reads 'GOBLIN ROAD. PAY OR ELSE.' Goblins giggle behind it.
{actor}'s 'papers' (a laundry list) are so official the goblins salute and give you THEIR gold.
The goblins squint, nod importantly, and wave you through.
'These are a drawing of a duck!' The goblins attack!
You charge! The goblins scream and draw their tiny swords.
The goblins count the coins six times, then let you pass.

title: The Hermit's Hut
text: Smoke curls from a crooked hut. An old hermit peers at you suspiciously through a cracked window.
A hut built into a tree. A sign reads: 'GO AWAY (unless you brought soup)'.
The hermit takes a liking to {actor} and reveals a secret about {antagonist}: a weakness, and a path.
The hermit draws you a crude map of the area.
The hermit shouts 'SOUP!' and slams the door.
The hermit has a surprising stock of potions, at surprising prices.

title: The Whispering Well
text: An old stone well. Faint whispers rise from the darkness below... they seem to know your names.
A well in the middle of nowhere. Something at the bottom is glowing.
The whispers reveal where an old adventurer hid their treasure!
The whispers speak of {antagonist}'s plans. Useful.
The whispers turn to screams. {actor} reels back, shaken.
At the bottom: bones, coins, and a glowing trinket.
{actor} slips and wakes the things living in the well!

options.label: Toss in a coin and wish

text: Plink. You feel slightly luckier.

title: Caught in the Storm
text: The storm hits hard. Lightning splits a tree nearby. You need shelter, fast.
Rain falls in sheets. The trail is turning to mud and the thunder is getting closer.
{actor} finds a dry cave. You wait out the storm in relative comfort.
The cave is occupied. By a bear. An annoyed bear.
You march on through the storm, soaked but determined.
Exhausted and chilled, everyone suffers.

title: A Lost Child
text: A small child sits crying on a stump. 'I followed the pretty lights and now I can't find home!'
'Are you heroes?' A muddy child looks up at you hopefully.
You return the child to their overjoyed family, who insist on rewarding you.
It takes all day, but you find the family eventually.
{actor}'s silly song stops the tears instantly. The child points the way home and gives you a 'magic' pebble.
The child cries harder. Still, you get them home.

title: Merchant Caravan
text: A colorful caravan rolls by. 'Wares! Wares from distant lands! Mostly legal!'
A caravan has stopped to water its camels. The merchant waves you over eagerly.
The merchant spreads out a blanket of goods.
{actor} haggles so well the merchant throws in a free potion out of respect.
The merchant is offended and raises all prices. You buy nothing.

title: The Sealed Door
text: A massive stone door carved with glowing runes blocks a tunnel. Something valuable lies beyond.
Runes glow on an ancient vault door. A riddle is carved above: 'Draw what has no end.'
{actor} traces the master rune. The door swings open on a forgotten armory!
The runes flare and the door grinds open. Treasure!
Wrong rune. Lightning crackles from the door!
With a mighty heave, {actor} drags the door open.
The door doesn't budge. {actor} pulls a muscle.

title: Dark Procession
text: Hooded figures walk in a line, chanting {antagonist}'s name. They carry a bound prisoner.
Torches in the dark: a cult procession heading toward a ritual site.
You strike from the shadows and free the prisoner, who reveals a secret of {antagonist}'s.
The cultists spot you! 'Seize them for the ritual!'
Hooded and chanting, you learn the ritual's location and sabotage it.
'That one's chanting the wrong words!' Busted.
The chanting fades. Somewhere, a ritual succeeds.

title: Swollen River
text: The river has burst its banks. The ford is a rushing torrent now.
A fast river, cold and deep. There's a ferry on the far side... with no ferryman.
You make it across, soaked and triumphant.
The current batters you against rocks before you claw your way out.
{actor} lashes together a sturdy raft. Smooth sailing!
The raft falls apart halfway. Everyone swims.

title: The Gambling Imp
text: A tiny red imp appears in a puff of smoke, shuffling cards. 'Fancy a game? Double or nothing, heroes!'
'Psst! Wanna bet?' An imp sits on a toadstool, rattling dice in a skull.
{actor} cleans the imp out completely! It vanishes, sobbing, leaving its lucky trinket.
{actor} wins! The imp pays up, grumbling.
The imp wins — of course it does. It takes your coins and cackles.
The imp wins {actor}'s shadow! It'll give it back... eventually. Brrr.
POOF. The imp is gone, leaving only a smell of sulfur and a few coins.
The imp blows a raspberry and disappears with your lunch.

title: The Leaning Tower
text: A wizard's tower leans at an alarming angle. Books flutter from its windows like birds.
The tower of some long-dead wizard. The door is open. The stairs go up... and also somehow sideways.
{actor} finds the wizard's spellbook and a pearl of power!
You recover several useful scrolls.
An animated book attacks {actor}. Papercuts. So many papercuts.
The wizard's old guardian is still down there — and so is the treasure.
Rats. Giant ones. Of course.

title: The Sleeping Ogre
text: An ogre snores in a clearing, a sack of loot under its head as a pillow.
Snoring like rockslides: an ogre, asleep on a pile of stolen goods.
{actor} swaps the sack for a rock. The ogre hugs the rock contentedly.
{actor} slips the sack free. The ogre mumbles and rolls over.
SNORT. The ogre opens one eye. Then the other.
You get the first hits in before it wakes!
You leave the ogre to its dreams.

title: Oasis
text: Palms and clear water shimmer ahead. Is it real?
An oasis! Real water, real shade, maybe a real mirage.
It's real! You drink deep and rest in the shade.
It's real... and so is the giant scorpion living in it.
No time to rest.

title: Shipwreck on the Shore
text: A broken ship lies on the rocks, gulls wheeling above. Crates bob in the surf.
The tide reveals a wreck. Its figurehead — a mermaid — seems to watch you.
You haul out crates of goods and a captain's strongbox.
The hold is home to sea-devils!
The log mentions a smuggler's cache nearby.
The ink has run. Something about 'never trust the parrot'.

title: Lights in the Marsh
text: Blue lights bob over the marsh, beckoning. 'This way,' they seem to say.
Floating lights drift through the reeds, just out of reach.
{actor} realizes it's a trap — and leads you around it to the bones of their past victims, and their treasure.
The lights lead you into deep bog. Then they attack!
You resist the lights' pull and slog onward.
{actor} wanders off in a trance and gets bitten by things in the water.

title: Busking Contest
text: A crowd gathers at a crossroads. A rival bard sneers: 'Anyone dare challenge me?'
A busking contest! The prize: a purse of gold and eternal glory (local).
{actor}'s song is so good the rival bard quits music forever. The crowd carries you on their shoulders.
{actor} wins the crowd! The purse is yours.
Booed off stage. A tomato hits {actor}. It was a good tomato.
The rival bard flees in tears. The crowd awards you the prize by default.
The crowd turns on you. You're run out of town with rotten fruit.

title: The Web-Choked Path
text: Thick webs block the path. Cocooned shapes hang from the trees... some of them twitching.
The trees ahead are draped in silk. Something skitters overhead.
The webs go up like paper. The spiders scatter — and a cocooned traveler thanks you with gold.
The fire draws the brood's attention!
You slip through without touching a single strand.
TWANG. The whole web shivers. Here they come.

title: The Four Statues
text: Four statues face inward around a sealed chest. Each holds out an empty hand. Pressure plates lie at their feet.
A circular chamber, four statues, four pressure plates. A plaque reads: 'Together, or not at all.'
The statues turn in unison and the chest springs open!
Wrong order. Darts fly from the walls!
With brute force you crack it open.
The statues come alive to defend it!

title: Refugees on the Road
text: A line of refugees flees the darkness spreading from {fortress}. 'It's getting worse every day,' says an old woman.
Families with carts piled high trudge past. They're fleeing {antagonist}.
The refugees are deeply grateful. Word of your kindness spreads.
They describe the enemy's patrols. You'll avoid the worst of them.
Their stories are terrifying and contradictory. You sleep badly.
Inspired by {actor}, the refugees turn back to defend their homes. The enemy's advance slows.
They're too frightened to listen.

title: A Warm Egg
text: In a scorched nest sits a single egg, warm to the touch and faintly glowing.
An egg the size of a melon, scaled and warm. Something inside taps back when you knock.
You wrap the egg in a cloak and slip away before its mother returns.
A shriek from above! A young dragon dives at you!
You leave the egg in peace. Somewhere, a dragon remembers your kindness.

title: A Quiet Road
text: For once, nothing tries to kill you. Birds sing. The road is pleasant.
A peaceful stretch of road. Someone suggests a song.
You walk in comfortable silence and arrive refreshed.
{actor} finds healing herbs and berries.
{actor} eats the wrong berry. Their tongue is blue for a day.

title: Wanted Poster
text: A weathered poster nailed to a tree: 'WANTED: Brave fools. Good pay.'
A notice flaps on a signpost, offering a bounty.
You tear down the poster. A new quest!
Somebody else's problem.

title: The Grumpy Oak
text: An ancient oak opens a bark-wrinkled eye. 'Hrrm. More two-legs. Stomping on my roots.'
A tree clears its throat. A very, very old tree. 'You may pass... if you are polite.'
The oak is mollified and drops a golden acorn into {actor}'s hands.
The oak laughs, a sound like a creaking ship, and blesses the whole party.
'Rude!' A branch swats {actor}.
The oak has seen everything for 500 years. It tells you where things are.
The oak rambles about squirrels for an hour.
You tiptoe around the roots.

title: Lost Hunting Party
text: Three nervous hunters huddle around a dead fire. 'Something took Barret. Something BIG.'
A hunter waves you down, pale. 'Please — our friend was dragged into the woods.'
{actor} finds the trail — and the beast still chewing on Barret's boot!
You lose the trail. The hunters give you a map for your trouble.
The hunters mark the spot on your map.

title: The Pixie Pickpocket
text: Something tiny and giggling zips past — and your coin purse is lighter!
A pixie the size of a thumb is juggling your gold coins, laughing.
{actor} snatches the pixie mid-air. It returns your gold — and then some, to be let go.
The pixie escapes with 20 gold, blowing a raspberry.
The pixie trades your gold back for a song. It's a good deal.
The pixie is unimpressed and keeps 10 gold.

title: The Hollow Log
text: A huge hollow log lies across the path. Something glitters inside. Something also growls inside.
A fallen tree, hollow as a drum. You hear... snoring?
{actor} pulls out a satchel left by some unlucky traveler.
A very angry badger. Ow.
With a heave the log rolls — revealing a cache of goods underneath.
The log doesn't budge. Something inside laughs at you.

title: Circle of Standing Stones
text: Seven mossy stones stand in a ring. The air hums. A druid in leaves watches you warily.
An ancient stone circle, with a druid tending a small fire at its heart.
The druid welcomes you. The ritual restores body and spirit.
You mess up the chant. The druid sighs and lets you rest anyway.

options.label: Ask the druid about the darkness

text: '{antagonist} poisons the land. Strike quickly.' She shows you a hidden path.
You leave it be and move on.

title: Arrows from the Trees
text: THWACK — an arrow lands in the tree beside {actor}'s head. 'Next one's in your eye! Drop the gold!'
Bandits drop from the branches all around you!
Weapons out!
{actor} convinces them you're broke heroes on a doomed quest. They feel sorry and give you snacks.
'Nice try.' They attack!
You hand over the gold. They melt back into the trees.

title: The Glade of Wishes
text: A glowing pool sits in a glade where no birds sing. A sign: 'One wish. Choose wisely.'
Starlight pools on the water of a hidden glade, even at noon.
Gold coins bubble up from the pool!
Fool's gold. It turns to leaves in your hand.
The party feels mightier.
Nothing happens. The pool seems disappointed in you.
The pool flares. Far away, {antagonist} screams.
The darkness is too strong. The pool goes still.

title: Suspicious Mushrooms
text: A patch of plump, delicious-looking mushrooms. Probably fine. Probably.
Mushrooms! Hundreds! Some are glowing a little.
{actor} cooks a feast. Everyone feels fantastic.
Hallucinations! {actor} spends an hour talking to a rock.
Very bad mushrooms.
Better safe than sorry.

title: A Bargain in the Bog
text: An old woman sits on a stump, knitting something wet. 'Lost, dearies? I could help... for a price.'
'Trade with old Granny?' A hag in a rocking chair floats on the swamp.
{actor} forgets their childhood pet's name. In return: a potion that glows.
She takes the memory AND laughs at you.
{actor} tricks the hag into giving away her lucky charm!
'Clever, clever.' She curses {actor} for the cheek.
She's furious! The swamp rises against you!
You politely decline and wade on.

title: Sucking Mud
text: The ground gives way. {actor} sinks up to the waist in sucking mud!
GLORP. The mud is eating {actor}.
Everyone heaves and {actor} pops free with a sound like a cork.
You get them out, but lose a pack in the process.
{actor} relaxes, spreads out, and floats free. Impressive.
Panicking only makes it worse. Exhausting.

title: Stilt Village
text: A village of huts on stilts rises from the mist. Lizardfolk eye you. One waves.
Frog-legged stilts, rope bridges, and curious lizardfolk faces.
The lizardfolk are fair traders.
They let you rest, in exchange for stories.
They hiss you away. Rude, but fair.
'The old one in the deep bog. She knows things.' They draw a map.

title: The Drowned Shrine
text: A temple roof pokes out of black water. Candles still burn inside, underwater.
Bells ring underwater from a sunken shrine.
{actor} surfaces clutching a holy relic!
Drowned things grab at {actor}'s ankles!
The drowned bells answer. You feel blessed.

title: The Frog Chorus
text: A thousand frogs are singing... in perfect harmony. They stop and stare at you.
Ribbit. Ribbit. RIBBIT. The frogs want you to sing.
The frogs are delighted! They gift you a glowing frog egg (it's a potion).
You become an honorary frog. The frogs will remember.
You hit a bum note. The frogs are deeply offended.
You tiptoe past the judgmental amphibians.

title: The False Lantern
text: A lantern bobs ahead, held by a hooded figure who never turns around.
'This way...' calls a voice, and a lantern swings in the mist.
{actor} realizes it's a trap — and you ambush the ambushers!
It's a trap!
You turn away. The lantern goes out with a hiss.

title: Rumbling Slopes
text: A rumble above. Snow and rock begin to slide toward you!
CRACK. The mountainside is coming down!
Everyone dives clear just in time!
Most of you make it; {actor} is clipped by a boulder.
The avalanche buries the party for a terrifying moment.
{actor} braces behind a rock outcrop and shields the party.
Brave, but painful.

title: The Old Dwarf Gate
text: A stone gate carved with dwarven runes. A riddle: 'Speak the word that every dwarf holds dear.'
An abandoned dwarf hold. The gate asks a question in old dwarvish.
'Beard!' The gate grinds open on a forgotten armory.
Wrong word. The gate stays shut and makes a rude noise.
{actor} finds a weak point and cracks it open.
Your pick bounces. Your arm hurts.

title: The Griffon's Nest
text: A huge nest of branches and bones on a ledge. Golden feathers. A griffon circles above.
Shiny things glint in a griffon nest.
{actor} grabs a fistful of treasure and slides down before the griffon notices.
SCREECH! The griffon dives!
The griffon accepts your offering and lets you rest in its shadow.
The griffon is not hungry. It is angry.

title: The Monk on the Peak
text: A monk sits cross-legged in the snow, smiling. 'You climb heavy. Sit. Breathe.'
A serene monk beckons you to share tea at a tiny shrine.
{actor} finds inner peace. Everyone feels lighter.
{actor} keeps peeking. The tea is nice anyway.
The monk teaches a trick or two.
You fall over. A lot. The monk giggles.

title: Kobold Traps
text: Tripwires. Pit traps. A sign reading 'NO TRAPS HERE' in kobold. Classic.
Pebbles click. Somewhere, a kobold whispers 'now!'
{actor} turns the traps around. The kobolds catch themselves and flee.
SPROING. A net drops on {actor} — and kobolds attack!
Traps spring on all sides! Kobolds swarm!

title: The Frozen Adventurer
text: An adventurer frozen in a block of ice, still clutching a sword and an expression of surprise.
Someone didn't make it. They're in the ice now, with all their stuff.
The ice melts. The adventurer's gear is in great condition!
Only the sword thaws out. Better than nothing.
You bury the fallen adventurer with honor. Their spirit nods to you.

title: Sandstorm!
text: A wall of sand roars toward you, blotting out the sun.
The wind screams and the dunes take flight.
You wait it out together, sand in every crevice.
The sand scours everyone raw.
{actor} keeps the party on course through the storm — and finds a shortcut.
You get completely lost.

title: The Buried Sphinx
text: A great stone face juts from the sand. Its eyes open. 'Answer, and be rewarded. Fail, and... well.'
A sphinx statue, half-buried, speaks in a voice like grinding millstones.
'Correct.' The sphinx grants a boon.
The sphinx is so impressed it tells you {antagonist}'s secret weakness.
'Wrong.' The sand beneath you shifts and swallows your pack.
'WRONG.' Stone guardians rise!
You don't answer riddles from giant cats.

title: The Lost Caravan
text: Bleached bones of camels and a half-buried wagon. Scorpion tracks everywhere.
A merchant caravan, lost to the sands long ago.
Silks, spices and gold!
Giant scorpions burst from the sand!
{actor} finds the merchant's hidden strongbox.

title: Mirage
text: An oasis with a palace of glass shimmers on the horizon. It moves when you look away.
A palace in the sand, beautiful and impossible.
It's real! A djinn's summer house, empty but for gifts left for guests.
It's a mirage. Hours wasted under the burning sun.
You trust your map, not your eyes.

title: The Salt Trader
text: A tall woman with a cart of salt and a parrot. 'Salt? Secrets? Swords? I sell all the S's.'
'Fine wares from far shores!' calls a trader under a parasol.
Her wares are... surprisingly good.
She whispers where something valuable is hidden.

effects.text: The trader whispered: the fortress has a weak gate. Strike at night.

title: The Ghostly Banquet
text: In a ruined hall, ghostly nobles feast at a table that isn't there. They notice you. 'Guests!'
Phantom music. Spectral dancers. A ghost holds out a goblet to you.
The ghosts are charmed by your manners and leave you an heirloom.
Eating ghost food is a bad idea. Brrr.
{actor} speaks the words of passing. The ghosts smile and fade, at peace.
The ghosts don't want to go. They get angry.

title: The Collapsing Floor
text: Crack. The floor tiles shift under your feet. The whole hall is going!
Dust rains down. The floor is splitting apart.
Everyone leaps to safety as the floor crashes into the depths.
A few of you fall into the lower level. Bruised, but you find something down there.
{actor} jams a beam into place. Solid work.

title: The Library of Echoes
text: Shelves of books whisper as you pass. One book is shouting.
A ruined library where the books read themselves aloud.
It's a spell scroll, desperate to be used!
The book bites {actor}.
You find notes about {antagonist}'s past.

effects.text: {antagonist} was once a hero, long ago.

title: The Garden of Statues
text: A garden full of very lifelike statues of adventurers. All looking terrified.
Statues everywhere. One of them blinked.
{actor} spots the basilisk's lair — and its treasure — without meeting its gaze.
You meet its gaze!
You leave quickly, eyes on your boots.

title: The Black Altar
text: A black altar drips with something dark. It pulses in time with the Doom Clock.
Candles around an altar to {antagonist}. The ritual is still active.
The altar shatters! The Doom Clock lurches backward.
Cultists rush in to defend it!
{actor}'s prayer burns the darkness from the stone.
The darkness lashes back.
You learn how the ritual works. Useful.

title: An Unattended Chest
text: A treasure chest, sitting alone in a ruin, with a little bit of drool on the lid.
A beautiful chest. Unlocked. Unguarded. Perfectly suspicious.
It's a mimic! But you got the first hit.
It's a mimic! And it's hungry!
Real treasure! Fancy that.
CHOMP.
You've read about these.

title: The Warden's Seal
text: A vault sealed with the mark of {antagonist}. Something inside resonates with your quest.
A magical seal hums on a stone vault door. It looks like part of a set.
The seal shatters, and inside lies a piece of the key you seek!
The seal flares and burns {actor}.
Guardians awaken!
{actor} picks the vault! Inside: treasure.
Click. Clunk. Nope.

title: Song on the Rocks
text: A beautiful voice drifts from the rocks. A merfolk sits combing her hair, watching you.
'Come closer,' sings someone in the surf.
Charmed by {actor}'s voice, the merfolk gifts a pearl.
She laughs and dives away, splashing you.
It was a sea hag all along!
'Dark ships sail for {fortress}.' She points out a safe cove.

title: Smugglers' Cove
text: Lanterns in a sea cave. Crates. Men with eyepatches arguing about rum.
Smugglers are unloading crates in a hidden cove.
You buy smuggled goods at a discount.
The Crown Wardens reward you for the tip.
They spot you sneaking off!
You sneak off with a crate of gold.
Caught red-handed!

title: Tide Pools
text: The tide is out. Pools glitter with crabs, starfish and something gold.
Low tide reveals pools full of life — and shiny things.
{actor} finds a gold ring stuck to a very annoyed crab.
Crab pinch! Right on the toe.
Sea air and sunshine. Everyone feels better.

title: The Dark Lighthouse
text: The lighthouse has gone dark. Ships will wreck tonight unless someone lights it.
A cold lighthouse. The keeper is missing.
The beacon blazes! Ships are saved. The town rewards you.
Something lives in the lighthouse now.
Not your problem. You hope.

title: Message in a Bottle
text: A bottle washes up at {actor}'s feet. There's a note inside.
Glass glints in the surf. A corked bottle with a scroll.
It's a treasure map! Sort of. It's a drawing of a crab with an X.
You toss it back. Somewhere, someone's rescue is delayed. Oops.

title: Harvest Festival
text: A village is celebrating the harvest! Music, pies, and a pig-wrestling contest.
Bunting, dancing, and the smell of roasting corn. A festival!
{actor} wins the pie-eating contest!
{actor} is beaten by a small child. Still fun.
The village cheers! Free food and lodging for the heroes!
Polite applause. Polite.
A lovely afternoon.

title: The Scarecrow Moved
text: A scarecrow stands in a field. You're sure it was facing the other way a moment ago.
That scarecrow is grinning. Scarecrows don't grin.
It screams and runs away, on fire, into the distance.
It's just a scarecrow. You burned a farmer's scarecrow.
It's a cursed farmer! You lift the curse and he rewards you.
It attacks!

title: The Crossroads
text: At a crossroads, a well-dressed stranger leans on a signpost. 'Fancy a deal? Power, now. Payment... later.'
A smiling stranger in red at a crossroads at midnight. Never a good sign.
Power floods into {actor}. Somewhere, a clock ticks faster.

effects.text: You made a deal at the crossroads. Someday, they'll come to collect.

text: The stranger takes your gold and your dignity.
{actor} wins a riddle contest against the devil! He vanishes in a huff, leaving his fiddle.
The devil wins. Of course. You lose a year of luck (and some gold).
You walk away without looking back. Wise.

title: The Windmill
text: A windmill's sails spin furiously though there is no wind. Something is inside, turning them.
CREEEAK. The windmill's arms swing toward you!
An ogre is using the windmill as a toy. You make friends with cake.
The ogre doesn't want friends.
{actor} topples the windmill! Ancient treasure spills from its foundations.
The windmill wins.

title: Royal Patrol
text: Royal soldiers in shiny armor ride up. 'Halt! Papers, citizens!'
A patrol of Crown Wardens blocks the road, demanding a toll for 'protection'.
The captain is impressed by your manners and shares rations.
The captain fines you for 'loitering'.
You help them clear a bandit nest — they share the bounty.
'We're on the King's business!' They salute and wave you through.
They don't buy it. Fine paid.

title: Stampede!
text: The ground shakes. A herd of wild cattle thunders straight toward you!
Something spooked the herd — and you're in the way!
Everyone dives clear of the thundering hooves.
Trampled. Ow. Ow. Ow.
{actor} bellows and the herd splits around you like a river!
The cows don't care about your feelings.

title: A Rival Bard
text: A flamboyant bard blocks the path. 'I am writing an epic! Do something heroic so I can steal it.'
'Hark! Adventurers! Material!' A bard scribbles notes as you approach.
The bard writes a song about you. It gets around.
The song is about how you tripped. It's catchy. Ugh.
He takes the coin and skips away, singing.

title: The Wandering Priest
text: A priest with a donkey offers blessings to all who pass. 'Free! Well. Donations welcome.'
A kindly old priest waves you over. 'You look like you could use a blessing.'
Warm light fills the party.
The priest's eyes widen. 'Bless you!' And he means it.
The priest lifts a curse from anyone who needs it... and reads your future.

effects.text: The priest foresaw a great battle at {fortress}.

title: A Very Good Dog
text: A scruffy dog trots up and drops a stick at {actor}'s feet. It has a collar: 'BISCUIT'.
A dog. A good dog. It wants to come with you.
Biscuit fetches the stick — and digs up a buried coin purse!
Biscuit's owners are thrilled and reward you with pie and gold.
You never find the owners. Biscuit is now your dog. Congratulations.

title: A Still-Warm Campfire
text: A campfire, still warm. Bedrolls. Packs. No people. Footprints lead into the dark.
Someone left in a hurry. Very recently.
You find the travelers fighting off monsters — and help them!
The footprints lead you into an ambush.
Supplies! And a bit of coin.
You take the warm fire for a quick rest.

title: The Peddler of Oddities
text: A tiny man with an enormous backpack. 'Oddities! Curiosities! Probably not cursed!'
'Psst. Want a jar of thunder? A left boot of speed?'
Everything is strange. Some of it is useful.
Inside the box... something good!

title: A Wounded Beast
text: A great wolf lies in a trap, whimpering. It watches you with intelligent eyes.
Something huge is caught in a hunter's snare and clearly in pain.
The beast limps away — then returns with a gift from its den.
It bites {actor} in panic before fleeing.

options.label: Put it out of its misery

text: A mercy, done quickly.
You leave it be and move on.

title: An Omen
text: The sky goes dark at midday. A red comet streaks toward {fortress}. Everyone shivers.
Birds fall silent. The shadows point toward {fortress}.
{actor} understands: {antagonist} is weaker than they seem.
The omen fills you with dread.
{actor}'s speech fills everyone with courage.

title: A Hidden Path
text: Between two boulders, a narrow trail you didn't notice before.
An old animal track, overgrown, heading straight where you want to go.
It cuts hours off your journey!
It's a dead end. Back you go.
You note it for later.

title: The Gamblers' Den
text: A tent full of gamblers shouting over dice. 'New blood! Roll with us!'
Dice clatter in a smoky tent. A sign reads: 'HIGH ROLLERS ONLY'.
{actor} wins big!
{actor} breaks the bank! The den owner gives them a lucky charm to go away.
The house always wins.
Accused of cheating! A brawl breaks out.
You catch the loaded dice. The other players reward you.

title: A Fallen Star
text: Something blazes across the sky and crashes nearby with a boom!
A smoking crater. In it, a glowing stone hums softly.
{actor} carefully cools and collects the star shard.
It's hot! Very hot!
The star glows warmly. You feel lucky.

title: A Desperate Messenger
text: A messenger on a lathered horse nearly runs you down. 'Heroes! Please! I need help!'
'Thank the gods — adventurers!' A messenger skids to a halt.
A new task, and a promise of reward.
The messenger tells you what they've seen of {antagonist}'s forces.

title: A Secret Note
text: {actor} finds a note tucked in their pack. 'You are my hero. — A secret admirer.'
A perfumed letter falls from {actor}'s cloak.
It's from a local goose enthusiast. They left you a gift too.
You never find out who. It haunts you, pleasantly.
{actor} leaves a reply. Days later, a basket of goodies appears.

title: The Hungry Troll
text: A troll sits on a rock, stomach growling like thunder. 'FOOD. Or YOU are food.'
A troll blocks the path, licking its lips.
You hand over your rations. The troll is pleased and shows you a shortcut.
{actor} cooks something so good the troll cries. It gives you its treasure hoard.
The troll hates it. Time to fight.
Remember: fire!

title: Trial of Spirits
text: Three shining spirits appear. 'Prove your worth, heroes — strength, wisdom and heart.'
'A trial,' say the voices of the ancestors. 'Pass, and be rewarded.'
{actor} lifts the impossible stone. The spirits nod.
The stone wins. The spirits are kind about it.
{actor} answers the spirits' question perfectly.
Wrong answer. The spirits sigh.
{actor}'s story moves the spirits to tears. They bless the party.
The spirits are unmoved.
